summary: Squeeze between two bounds from besselSize_le_norm_mul.

steps.lean:
@[fun_prop] lemma continuous_besselSize : Continuous (@besselSize 𝔰) := .of_at fun y ↦ by
    refine .squeeze ?_ ?_ ((div_le_iff₀' (Units.norm_pos _)).2 <|
      besselSize_le_norm_mul · y) (besselSize_le_norm_mul y) <;>
  apply (ContinuousAt.tendsto (by fun_prop (disch := simp))).trans <;> simp
steps.claim: Continuity at y: for y' near y, besselSize(y)/‖y'⁻¹y‖ ≤ besselSize(y') ≤ ‖y⁻¹y'‖·besselSize(y) (besselSize_le_norm_mul, twice), and both bounds tend to besselSize(y) because ‖y⁻¹y'‖ and ‖y'⁻¹y‖ tend to ‖1‖ = 1 (continuity of inversion, multiplication and the norm).
